cat <<'SCRIPT' | sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/secure-mount.sh
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/root/secure.img
KEY=/etc/luks-keys/secure.key
MAPNAME=secure
MOUNT=/srv/secure

case "$1" in
start)
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
  if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
    LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f --show "$IMG")
  fi
  if [ ! -e /dev/mapper/$MAPNAME ]; then
    cryptsetup luksOpen "$LOOPDEV" $MAPNAME --key-file "$KEY"
  fi
  mkdir -p "$MOUNT"
  if ! mountpoint -q "$MOUNT"; then
    mount /dev/mapper/$MAPNAME "$MOUNT"
  fi
  ;;
stop)
  umount "$MOUNT" 2>/dev/null || true
  cryptsetup luksClose $MAPNAME 2>/dev/null || true
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
  [ -n "$LOOPDEV" ] && losetup -d "$LOOPDEV" 2>/dev/null || true
  ;;
esac
SCRIPT

echo done
